name: Beastify
desc:
Welcome to Beastify!  

✨[UPD 5]

🎃Halloween: Pumpkins added in maps! Destroy them to get pumpkin coins, use coins to exchange Pumpkin Pack or use Robux to buy directly!
✨New Map: Map 8 Spider Cave is now unlock! Max level is increased to Lv56!
🏆Weekly Pass: Weekly Pass is added! Return the game after 7 days to get limited OP Pet Capybara!
⚔️Party: Party Invite is added! Invite other players for a party to get extra boosts!

⚔️ Eat to gain levels!
🧬 Gain levels to unlock new Beast!
💰 Collect Coins & Pets!
